All panels are produced by
[`script/FigureS6.R`](https://github.com/dzemmour/immgenT-cosmo-paper/blob/main/script/FigureS6.R).
The code below is shown for reference (not re-executed on this page); the
images are its pre-rendered output.

Panel **S6a** shows the Miller et al. dataset on its own UMAP with the immgenT
unclassified cells marked. It needs that study's own embedding, which is not
part of the deposited data, and is not reproduced here.

## Setup

```{r figs6-setup, code=code_for("../script/FigureS6.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (B) Non-T cells as a positive control {#figs6b}

```{r figs6b-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS6.R", "S6b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs6b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6b_MDE_nonT_cells.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 6B.** All-T MDE with T cells from 16 external studies
integrated by T-RBI, immgenT cells in the background (grey). Non-T cells from
the external studies (red) cluster separately, demonstrating that integration
does not force overlap with T cells. They are the one population certain to be
absent from a T-cell reference and so serve as the positive control for
detecting states the reference lacks.
:::

## (C, E) Unannotated fractions per study {#figs6ce}

```{r figs6ce-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS6.R", "S6c/S6e"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs6ce-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6c_barplot_unannotated_level1.png",
                          "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6e_barplot_unannotated_level2.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 6C, E.** Bar plots showing the proportion of cells from
each external study that are not annotated with a T-cell lineage (level 1, C)
and the proportion of T cells not annotated with an immgenT cluster (level 2,
E). A cell counts as unannotated at cluster level either when its confidence
falls below threshold or when it is confidently placed in a lineage but left
unresolved within it.
:::

## (D) Lineage markers across integrated cells {#figs6d}

```{r figs6d-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS6.R", "S6d"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs6d-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="32%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c(
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6d_FeaturePlot_Cd4.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6d_FeaturePlot_Cd8b1.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6d_FeaturePlot_Cd8a.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6d_FeaturePlot_Trdc.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6d_FeaturePlot_Foxp3.png",
  "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6d_FeaturePlot_Zbtb16.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 6D.** All-T MDE showing expression of Cd4, Cd8b1, Cd8a,
Trdc, Foxp3 and Zbtb16 in the external studies, illustrating concordance
between lineage marker expression and immgenT positioning. Marker expression is
not used by the mapping, so this agreement is an independent check on the
annotation.
:::

## (F) Cluster-level unannotated T cells {#figs6f}

```{r figs6f-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS6.R", "S6f"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs6f-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="50%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6f_MDE_unannotated_level2.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 6F.** All-T MDE with integrated external T cells in the
foreground and immgenT cells in grey. T cells unannotated at cluster level
(red) remain embedded within the immgenT manifold and do not form distinct
clusters, which is what distinguishes ordinary boundary ambiguity from a state
the reference lacks.
:::

## (G, H) Discovery score {#figs6gh}

```{r figs6gh-code, code=code_for("../script/FigureS6.R", "S6g/S6h"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r figs6gh-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6g_MDE_discovery_score.png",
                          "assets/ExtendedDataFigure6/S6h_discovery_score_by_dataset.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Extended Data Fig. 6G, H.** **G**: all-T MDE coloured by the single-cell
discovery score for the external studies; non-T cells exhibit high scores
(red; > 1.1). **H**: distribution of discovery scores across external studies,
including non-T cells as positive controls. High scores indicate query cells
that form coherent states outside the immgenT reference. Each score is computed
in its own study's PCA space, independently of the integration it audits.
:::
